purpose: Instructions for an LLM to emit valid diagram JSON that the editor and viewer can import. Catalogs of types, icons, themes, and card skeletons are merged in at generate time.

outputContract.emit: A single JSON object. No markdown fences unless the user asked for fenced output.

rootKeys.groupings: optional coordinated-selection groups (not a visible box)
rootKeys.recentColors: optional hex strings used in this diagram
rootKeys.canvasBackgroundColor: optional CSS colour for the viewport
rootKeys.globalProperties: optional string map; %key% in labels resolves at display time

outputContract.ids: Stable unique strings per node. Hyphens/underscores OK; no spaces. Connections.from/to must match node ids. Give connections an id when two edges share the same pair.

editProtocol.input: Current diagram JSON plus a natural-language edit.
editProtocol.output: The complete updated diagram (full nodes + connections arrays), not a diff.
rules: Preserve ids of objects the user did not ask to replace so connections stay attached.
To move/style an object, copy the node and change only the requested fields.
To delete, omit that node and drop connections that referenced it.
To add, insert a new node with a new unique id and optional connections.
Do not invent type strings; use catalogs.genericTypes or resource-types.json.
Keep layout: if adding a node, place it on the same grid as neighbours (see layoutRules).

typeIdRules.slug: resource display name, spaces to hyphens, lower-case (e.g. 'EC2 Instance' → ec2-instance)
remaps: Lucide palette → generic.icon.{iconName slug} plus iconType lucide and iconName PascalCase
Emoji palette → generic.emoji.{name-slug} plus iconType emoji and emoji character
Custom image → generic.icon.custom with https imageUrl
typeIdRules.neverUse: Bare names like 'Lambda' or 'Kubernetes'. Always the dotted type from the catalog (aws.compute.lambda, aws.databases.aurora, generic.user.user).
typeIdRules.categoryGotchas: Look up the exact category in resource-types.json. AWS uses databases (plural), not database. Storage S3 is aws.storage.simple-storage-service.

layoutRules.coordinates: Canvas pixels. x right, y down. Never stack everything at (0,0).
layoutRules.flow: Left→right for user→api→data. Top→bottom for layers/pipelines. Align peers on the same x or y.

sizes.icon: Omit width/height; use nodeSize normal|half|quarter|double (base tile 80px).

layoutRules.labels: 2–5 words on label. Longer notes in info. Shapes: textPosition above or center. Icons: label under the glyph by default.

colors.format: CSS hex (#rrggbb or #rgb). Reuse 2–4 accents plus neutrals.
colors.contrast: Dark text #0f172a/#111827 on light fills; light text #f8fafc on dark fills.

nodeVisual.gradient: backgroundColors [start, end], gradientAngle 0–360 (90–135 reads well). Border gradient: borderColors + borderGradientAngle.
nodeVisual.shadow: boolean; use on 1–3 focal nodes only.
nodeVisual.cornerRadius: 0–1 on rounded rect / cards / progress (0 square, 1 pill).

text.richLabel: Array of { text, bold?, italic?, underline?, listType bullet|numbered, lineJustify, lineFontSize, lineFontWeight, lineFontFamily }.

iconChrome.noIconBackground: true removes the white tile behind the glyph
iconChrome.iconColor: hex for Lucide; set iconColorEnabled true to apply

styling.themes: Built-in theme ids/colours are in catalogs.themes after generate. Copy a theme's border/background/text/line colours onto nodes rather than inventing a parallel palette.

routing.orthogonal: smoothCorners true for rounded bends. fromPreferredExit/toPreferredEntry: top|bottom|left|right|center. Left-to-right flow: right exit, left entry.
routing.waypoints: [{ x, y, id? }] absolute canvas. Advanced; omit unless routing around shapes.
routing.orthogonalCustomRoute: true + waypoints = manual polyline (no auto obstacles).

markers.text: optional label on the line; embed \n for multi-line labels
markers.textFontSize: label font size in px, 8–48 (default 12 when omitted)

animation.use: At most one primary link unless asked.

resource.when: Cloud/tech icons: aws.*, azure.*, gcp.*, k8s.*, programming.*, onprem.*, generic.user|device|os|office|status.*
resource.notes: Do not set file/provider unless you copied them from the catalog entry. ResourceIcon resolves the SVG from type.

text.generic.text.textbox: Multi-line box. Prefer richLabel for formatting.

chart.required: chart object whose kind matches the type suffix (pie|bar|line|ring|grid|gantt|loop).

grid.role: This is the table/matrix/heatmap. There is no generic.table type.
grid.cells: Row-major, length should be cols*rows. Unfilled cells: filled false or fillStyle none. fillStyle: none|solid|gradient|hue-step|theme-hue|default.

gantt.role: Project timeline with phase/task rows and draggable bars. Timeline columns are months (or any units); bars use fractional column units in [0, cols].
gantt.bars: start/end are fractional column units (0=first column start, cols=last column end). variant task|gate. Phase rows are headers and do not take bars. Optional colours: row.chipFill / row.labelColor; bar.fill / bar.border / bar.labelColor; chart taskBarFill, gateBarFill, taskChipFill, taskLabelColor, phaseLabelColor, gateLabelColor.

loop.role: Circular process chart: square node, hub in the centre, items equally spaced around a ring, clockwise arrows between items. Optional dashed inward arrows from items to the hub.
loop.items: Variable length (1–16). Layout places items evenly around the circle. spokeLabel is the optional inward-arrow caption. showInwardArrows false hides hub spokes. rotateItems true turns boxes tangent to the ring with circular pie-slice arrows. arrowWidth (0.5–6 SVG units) sets loop and inward arrow stroke thickness.

arrow.role: Segmented circular process arrows: square node, variable wedges with labels, clockwise or anticlockwise flow. arrowStyle chevron|triangle|overlap. colorMode same|hint|hue-step. segmentFillStyle solid|gradient (gradient follows each arc: segmentFillStart at the tail, segmentFill at the head).
arrow.items: Variable length (2–16). Text sits in each wedge. hint tints one fill; hue-step rotates hue per segment. Optional startAngleDeg (−45…+45) fine-tunes ring rotation. Optional segmentBorder + segmentBorderWidth (0–8) outlines each wedge. segmentFillStyle gradient blends segmentFillStart (tail) to segmentFill (head) along the arc. Rounded overlap always uses gapDeg 0 (segments touch).

chart.seriesFill: fillStyle none|solid|gradient; gradientColors [start,end]; labelColor on slices.

card.required: type generic.card.{templateId}, card.templateId same suffix, card.elements tree, width/height/sizeMode custom.
card.how: Copy defaultElements for that template from catalogs.cardTemplates. Change only text, tag, iconRef, and colours. Keep element ids — the renderer keys off them.
card.iconRef: Same as a canvas icon: type + optional iconType/iconName/emoji/file.

mindmap.connections: Tree edges may set mindmapRole tree and mindmapPrimary true.

antiPatterns: type strings that are not in the catalog (use generic.object.rectangle + label instead).
Omitting chart on generic.chart.* or card.elements on generic.card.*.
card.templateId that does not match the type suffix.

cardTemplates.notes: Shell uses node borderColor (default #ed7100). Corner icon defaults to aws.compute.compute-optimizer, nodeSize half, noIconBackground true.
Same element ids as dashboard-score. Default title Ranking, value 25, green gradient #bbf7d0→#16a34a, decor Globe.
Same ids. Title Incentives, subtitle worth of, value $ 15, blue gradient, decor MapPin.
Same ids as other dashboard-* cards.

editable: entries rows: row-N with time + session text
